card_capacity_note: Use observed Torch total_memory23.518GiB, not nominal4090/24GB or NVML nominal capacity.
phase_lifetime_evidence: DeepSpeed stage_1_and_2.py step creates a flat BF16 gradient partition and casts it to FP32, then frees parameter grads and sets averaged_gradients[group]=None before calling native optimizer.

Therefore9N+FP32 gradient+foreach buffer is an overcount if all are treated simultaneously; the optimizer-state phase has model2N+master2N+moments4N+mastergrad2N+sqrt temporary2N=12N, with logits and runtime overhead additional.
Native Torch2.6 AdamW allocates exp_avg and exp_avg_sq lazily in _init_group on first step even when learning rate is zero.

Native default CUDA AdamW uses foreach when foreach/fused unspecified. With standard scalar betas, no maximize/amsgrad/capturable variants, denominator _foreach_sqrt is the principal extra FP32 partition-sized tensor, followed by in-place transformations.
DeepSpeed grad norm uses per-gradient double() temporary; rank owning the large embedding may transiently need up to2.328GiB for that conversion.

Gradient accumulation can briefly retain previous averaged BF16 partition plus new current partition; the5GiB original forward/backward reserve must cover this, communication and checkpointed activations.
The probe retains BF16 logits through engine.step; include0.418GiB at micro8/max184.

GPU reserved memory includes reusable cached blocks; the LoRA16.89GiB reserved peak must not be scaled as irreducible full-finetune live tensor memory. Fragmentation and non-PyTorch allocations still require actual F06 calibration.

recommendation.immediate: Run the already authorized F06 path first and read both rank actual allocated/reserved/NVML peaks through its first zero-LR AdamW state allocation and second nonzero update. No extra standalone CUDA test required.
recommendation.F17_micro8_condition: Keep preferred micro8×acc4 only if F06-calibrated conservative peak plus non-PyTorch/context allowance leaves at least1.5–2GiB below observed23.518GiB; current static22GiB envelope alone is not a safety confirmation.
recommendation.fallback: If calibration does not leave that headroom, choose authorized micro4×acc8 before the first F17 update. It reduces logits/activations/cache pressure without changing global64 or optimizer mathematics.
recommendation.hard_boundary: Micro reduction does not reduce the approximately19.244GiB optimizer tensor floor. If that phase plus actual overhead cannot fit safely, mark F17 resource BLOCKED; do not change optimizer/offload/trainable scope.
recommendation.budget_caution: First LR0 update still allocates moments and foreach temporary; an OOM there can consume the conservative charged update allowance before useful nonzero update. Avoid trial-and-error optimizer changes.
